ai_summary: 3M India Limited's Ahmedabad plant has fully resumed manufacturing operations as of August 10, 2026, following a temporary shutdown caused by heavy rainfall and flooding. While the company continues to assess the overall impact, potential financial repercussions are mitigated as all assets are adequately insured and the matter has been intimated to the insurance company. This update signifies a swift recovery from the disruption, indicating a return to normal production with no immediate red flags.
